findings.title: An empty scope authorizes every warehouse
findings.trigger: A key issued without warehouses (issue_key's default), narrowed to none with set_scope(key, []), or read from a key row with no warehouses field calls reserve, confirm, cancel, pick, or stock.
findings.impact: authorize skips the scope test whenever key.warehouses is empty, so a key that normalize_scope documents as able to act in no warehouse can move stock in every warehouse. An admin who parks a kiosk key by clearing its scope widens it to the whole network instead. The check should be WILDCARD not in scope and warehouse_id not in scope, with no truthiness short-circuit.

findings.title: The warned set keeps every hold that is confirmed or cancelled after its notice
findings.trigger: A hold made with hold_minutes gets its hold_expiring notice and the client then confirms or cancels it, which is the normal path for most holds.
findings.impact: Ids leave _warned only on the expiry branch of tick. A warned hold that is confirmed or cancelled drops out of holds_expiring_before, so its id is never discarded, and the long-lived worker process gains one entry per warned hold for its whole life. Prune _warned to the ids still in due at the end of each tick.

findings.title: Expired holds count as reserved again, so their units are locked for good
findings.trigger: A hold made with hold_minutes lapses and the ExpiryWorker marks it expired.
findings.impact: reserved_in_bin releases a lapsed hold only through lapsed(), which is true only while the status is HELD. Once expire_hold sets EXPIRED the reservation is neither PICKED, CANCELLED, nor HELD, so it is counted as reserved again, and EXPIRED is terminal, so it stays counted. Every expired cart permanently removes its units from free_in_bin, available, and reserve, which is the stock the feature exists to release. The tuple needs EXPIRED next to PICKED and CANCELLED.
